footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income: includes a R$2.7B income tax benefit; after R$6.0B of other items, net. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 5.4% to R$38.1B in 2025. Gross margin was 37.0%, versus 54.1% a year earlier, and operating income fell 14.2% to R$11.7B, a 30.7% margin.
Net income fell 11.7% to R$8.5B, or R$2.47 per share. Operating cash flow was R$8.4B and free cash flow R$8.4B, versus R$7.4B; Sabesp returned R$2.4B through dividends.
highlights: Free cash flow rose 12.9% to R$8.4B.
Cash ended the year at R$95.4M.
sources: Companhia de Saneamento Básico do Estado de São Paulo - SABESP Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

strategy: Expansion Capital Expenditures: focused on meeting the goals of universalization of water supply, sewage and sewage treatment
Renewal Capital Expenditures: intended for the maintenance of our existing assets
Operational Efficiency Capital Expenditures: aimed at increasing efficiency, automation and reducing water losses
Indirect Capital Expenditures: directed to administrative investments and to support our infrastructure
